scope: Three proposed private CPU true JSphCpuSingle::Run jobs only: Debug two-step smoke, then independent Release coarse/half. No production edit, public gravity unlock, wall, GPU, main-loop transcription, force assignment or initial physical-state rewrite.

source_review_identity.meaning: Current Gamma2sites candidate reviewed, not proof of this new helper build/run. Root must bind the complete current authoritative CPU build, 85 non-main objects, tools, runtime, source snapshots and candidate native regressions before any helper or actual invocation.

immutable_reader_include.use: Direct main-renamed include, exactly one AppInfo. Reuse only neutral NativeArray/Native/Sequence/Metadata(false)/numeric helpers. Never call its public Load, Read, Energy, Physical or old 26-column exporter; it cannot interpret this private three-J CPU schema.

original_control.matching: Actual J1/p0 unmodified lattice and 32-column XML sine velocities, not old mapped-J/p128 private26 controls. Coarse dt2^-24, half2^-25 verified from actual retained runtime. Retained public CPU has six native J-derived arrays plus PosDiv; new private CPU has only three. Common fields may later be compared honestly by ID, not by fabricating missing private arrays or relabelling its backend.

configuration.geometry: 512 native IDs0..511, fixed0, 32x16 XZ periodic, dp1/256,Lx1/8,Lz1/16. BI4 is not copied/rewritten by authoring or this helper; root may copy the sealed exact source only after full review. No GenCase.
configuration.actual_gravity: Both casedef/constantsdef and execution/constants are (-8,0,0). This is uniform body acceleration/freefall in a periodic cell, not an impossible globally linear periodic hydrostatic pressure.
configuration.physical_initial_state: Exact original BI4 positions plus the exact original 32 fluidvelocity initialization entries: vx=(1/512)sin(2pi*x/Lx), vy=vz=0,p=p0=stress=theta=0,J1,n.25. The fixture never assigns these fields.
configuration.material: Original exact K89478488,G134217728,Kw67108864,rho02048,rhow1000,n0.25; k0 is float-promoted1e-4. Smooth k=k0 exp((J-1)/((1-n0)*Ck)),Ck2^-13 unchanged. Manufactured Ck is not a soil calibration recommendation.
configuration.public_XML_keys: HydroMechDynamicSeepage=0, HydroMechConductivityModel=0, HydroMechConductivityCk=0 explicitly. The derived-class constructor alone sets Observer/Feedback/DynamicPorePressure/DynamicPoreConductivity=true,Ck2^-13. Do not run these XMLs with canonical main and call that the new model; only this explicitly bound private helper is the solver entry.
configuration.retained_options: Fresh CPU OMP1, fixed dt, Symplectic/Wendland, zero artificial viscosity/DDT/HG/SPR/damping/shifting/load/drainage/initialization mode; SavePosDouble1; PartsOutMax0; passive Rhop700..3000; full original metadata/particles/geometry/velocity XML retained.

protocol.sequence: Root first full source/recipe read, freeze exact authors/current build and source. Then explicit one Debug smoke actual call and separately reader; only after it passes may root admit each Release actual coarse/half and its separate review. No automatic invocation in this CPP. Root-owned wrapper must hash input XML/BI4, current source/build/runtime/program and all raw outputs before/after offline review, seal solver exit before analysis, and never rerun a completed solve after reader-only failure.
protocol.ordinary_CLI_restrictions: CPU and OMP1 required; no -partbegin, NstepsBreak, TimeMax/TimeOut CLI override, SvAllSteps, help/info. Run is exactly base JSphCpuSingle::Run; protected nonvirtual LoadConfig/Interaction/SaveData are not overridden.
protocol.live_finish: Checks true Run final clock/steps/locked dt and released Pre arrays, real loaded flags/gravity/material and all512 normal-fluid IDs, then writes live_final.csv and actual_complete.json. This is not an independent record of every internal stage call.

output_schema.native: Original15 actual typed arrays plus PoroVolumeRatio/PoroPorosity/PoroThetaLastStage double. No public dynamic metadata, PoroCurrentVolume/PoroMixtureDensity/PoroHydraulicConductivity or PosDiv; absence is explicitly checked, never filled with fake zeros.
output_schema.binary: Both binaries: little-endian native unsigned header[512,33,samples], then per frame actual double time plus512 ID-ordered rows of33 doubles. physical.bin is inertial actual output (V/rho/k derived from actual saved J, not extra native arrays). frame.bin changes only position/velocity/material-displacement columns by the declared accelerating-reference transform.
output_schema.clocks: Every3/257 PART must exist exactly, one piece/no exclusions, actual time=part*cadence, native saved step=part?round(time/dt)-1:0 and native SymplecticDtPre=dt; signed dterror must be actually present double/finite and<=1e-14, not abs(dterror).
output_schema.force_stage_note: Saved theta is native last-stage theta, not recomputed endpoint divergence. Saved current CFL/diffusion/domain checks are not independent observations of every force-stage C/Ace/gradient cache. Real Run executes the production predictor/corrector guards, but the fixture does not claim counted callbacks.

scientific_gates.unchanged_native: All native typed fields finite, exact512 IDs, no exclusions/plastic/load,p00, native float excess=p-p0 and float display stresses round actual double stress, passive legacy rho700..3000. J>1-n0,|J-1|<=1e-4,positive finite n/V/rho/k; actual native n ledger relative5e-13 and solid-volume residual<=5e-13.
scientific_gates.unchanged_nonempty: Smoke max|J-1|>0; full>1e-8 and spatial current-k span/k0>=.005. These are inherited natural-evolution activation checks, not a new pressure-accuracy assertion.
scientific_gates.unchanged_necessary_scales: Saved cu*dt/h<=.01,D(J)*dt/h^2<=.01 with gamma_ref=rhow*9.80665; original strict positive-k continuum margin>64DBL_EPS max(rho,rhow). Actual DtVariable fixed/current-step/half-stage/gradient guards remain source enforced with no clipping or DtMin uplift. No claim of sufficient stability.
scientific_gates.accelerating_energy: Use v*=v-g*t in kinetic energy and the original stored elastic/pore energy at each saved J; entire saved history energy/E0<=original1.1. Inertial energy/E0 is recorded separately and is not the g0 wave-energy acceptance quantity.
scientific_gates.future_half: Not implemented/performed by this helper. Root must separately compare all257 actual-matched coarse/half frames under original pressureRMS<=5Pa,material-u-max<=.005mm and normalized p/v/u<=1e-4. Use frame material displacement consistently; no interpolation/exclusion.
scientific_gates.future_frame: g0 coarse/half comparisons must use the matching true retained states and frame.bin; common initial fields should be checked. Absolute5Pa/.005mm caps may be retained, but stricter per-field/normalized reference-frame roundoff budgets are PENDING root prior declaration, not fitted after seeing new runs. No frame-equivalence pass is emitted by this CPP.
scientific_gates.future_body_g_integration: MANDATORY PENDING gate, not inferred from small p/J differences: root must seal the real Run.out/header loaded Gravity=(-8,0,0), actual constructor/private flags and source identity, then compare actual native uniform velocity increment against g*t using a prior float-accumulation/stage-response budget. Missing or doubled body-g should differ by |g*t|; the prior budget must resolve that comfortably, not simply use5Pa/.005mm (end body displacement is only3.725290298461914e-9m). history.csv records unweighted_mean_vx, unweighted_mean_frame_vx and expected_uniform_body_velocity_shift as DIAGNOSTICS ONLY. The helper does not prove a physical mass-weighted CoM law; mixture rho*V varies withJ and unweighted internal force need not exactly cancel. Do not claim actual body-g integration passed until a separately reviewed independent native/reference calculation and nonempty wrong-missing/double discrimination have passed. No original coordinates/velocities are changed to obtain the comparison.
scientific_gates.future_flux_sensitivity: Initial J1 makes GJ=0; do not demand or claim initial chain activation. Along-wave g and later variable J allow a wrong explicit g term to matter, but actual Gk dot g signal versus the prior propagated rate/flux budget must still be independently established from later same-stage fields before any nonzero-gravity physical/public admission. q is not a saved native production field here; pressure equality alone cannot prove q correct.

actual_integration_formula.locations: JSphCpuSingle::Run1316/ComputeStep_Sym959 and JSphCpu Pre4545/Corr4694; exact line numbers are audit-location hints, not source identity proof.
actual_integration_formula.endpoint: Compare x*=unwrap(x)-.5*g*t^2, v*=v-g*t. This short fixture requires every point remain inside its primary periodic interval, so no inferred wrap counts are fabricated; it does not test a boundary-crossing trajectory.
actual_integration_formula.predictor: At step t_n,dt, predictor uses x_half=x_n+.5dt*v_n, not a second-order continuous midpoint location. Therefore gravity-vs-zero-g position shift at predictor is .5g*t_n^2+.5g*t_n*dt (no g*dt^2/8), and velocity shift g*(t_n+.5dt).
actual_integration_formula.corrector: Corrector adds (Ace_half+g)*dt to v_n and trapezoidal endpoint displacement .5dt*(v_n+v_new), giving endpoint .5g*t^2. Uniform shifts leave relative geometry exact in algebra, not guaranteed native floating bitwise equivalence.
actual_integration_formula.acceleration: Ace stores a_s-g, completed before dynamic rate. The complete pressure operator consumes Gp+rhow*Ace with no extra +/-g. A body-gravity vector is not the material k-to-mobility reference acceleration.
